title: Ivo and the Parish
author: W. M. Delacroix
blurb: Coral Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
